{{Top|leg}}
The '''master detonation signal''' was used by [[Kueller]] to detonate the [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive charges]] placed into every [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufactured at the [[Telti droid construction facility|droid factories]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telti/Legends|Telti]]. While on Telti investigating the [[Bombing of the Senate Hall]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] managed to disable the master detonation signal when Kueller triggered the signal on [[Almania]].<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
